shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls __agent_eval__

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -ril "calendar" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "date|day"
timeout 30 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

timeout 180 npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; cat dist/esm/components/CalendarView/CalendarView.d.ts | head -60; cat package.json | grep -A15 '"exports"'; grep -rn "import.*css" dist/esm/components/Calendar/*.js | head
